  • Constructor Details

    • SmartAgriTruck

      public SmartAgriTruck(String vehicleId, double maxCapacityKg, int numberOfAxles, double minTemperatureCelsius, String driverName)
      Creates a smart agricultural truck with driver and refrigeration details.
      Parameters:
      vehicleId - unique identifier for the vehicle
      maxCapacityKg - maximum cargo capacity in kilograms
      numberOfAxles - number of truck axles
      minTemperatureCelsius - minimum supported temperature in Celsius
      driverName - name of the assigned driver
